title: Orion: LLVM introduces timing-vulnerable optimizations into ML-KEM and ML-DSA operations intended to be constant-time
description: LLVM's compilation of the internal function conditional_sub_u32() in the Orion cryptographic library introduces timing-vulnerable conditional jumps on certain CPU targets lacking conditional move/select instructions. This affects ML-KEM and ML-DSA cryptographic operations, potentially leaking secret-dependent information. The issue impacts specific Linux targets including i586, s390x, and x86_64 architectures. The vulnerability could enable recovery of cryptographic keys depending on the compiler, CPU, and attacker proximity. Fixed versions 0.17.16 and 0.18.1 address this by rewriting conditional_sub_u32() to consider conditional move/jump availability.
